method: Actual visible Godot viewport, 3 second settle and bounded 8 second sample. Renderer frame_post_draw events are measured separately from process callbacks and engine delta. No display-presentation or GPU timestamp claim.
gpu_sample_note: nvidia-smi samples whole GPU; other owner processes may contribute

rendered_frame_window.note: Renderer frame completion callbacks, not display presentation or GPU timestamps

viewport_render_timing.planar_note: Null when no update request since previous callback. Non-null is latest available readback tagged by request delta, not a proven same-frame GPU pass. Cached readings must not be accumulated; no combined main+planar timing is synthesized.
viewport_render_timing.readback_note: Latest reported per-viewport render times; may lag callback. Zero is unavailable/unresolved, not proof of zero cost. CPU excludes scripts and file IO. Not display presentation timing.
